title: Billy Joel Tribute Booklet
summary: A 16-page editorial tribute to Billy Joel, combining introspective songwriting, archival-inspired references, and a restrained late-1970s visual palette.
meta: 16-page editorial booklet, typography and layout, color system

items.label: Project
items.text: This editorial booklet pays tribute to Billy Joel’s songwriting, with particular attention to the introspective themes of Vienna. The design draws from the visual atmosphere of the late 1970s and early 1980s, translating the music’s reflective quality into a printed editorial experience.

items.label: Creative direction
items.text: A restrained palette of cream, charcoal, and burgundy establishes a nostalgic, understated tone. Archival-inspired visual references support the historical atmosphere, while the editorial structure gives the music and its themes room to breathe. The design prioritizes mood and pacing over unnecessary decoration.

items.label: Design approach
items.text: The 16-page booklet uses typography, image selection, and page sequencing to create a cohesive reading experience. The design connects the music’s cultural context with its more personal themes, treating the booklet as both a tribute and an editorial interpretation.
